item.title: Sooryavanshi’s Record 175 Dominates U-19 Cricket World Cup Final
item.description: GUWAHATI: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi delivered a stunning performance in the ICC Under-19 World Cup 2026 final on Friday, February 6, putting India in a commanding position against England at the Harare Sports Club. The young star narrowly missed what could have been the first-ever double century in an Under-19 World Cup final, falling 25 runs short. item.description: GUWAHATI: The death toll in the explosion inside an illegal coal mine in Meghalaya on Thursday, February 5, has gone up to 19 with the recovery of one more body on Friday. item.title: Alumni of Shillong's Loreto, Pinemount & St Edmund's Reunite to Stage Play “A Wedding To Remember” in Guwahati on Feb 8
item.description: GUWAHATI: Guwahati is set to witness a new theatrical offering as a newly formed cultural and charitable collective, Echoes of the Hills, stages its debut production “A Wedding To Remember” on February 8. The play will be performed at the Sri Sri Damodaradeva International Auditorium, located within the Srimanta Sankaradeva Kalakshetra complex, Panjabari, starting at 6:30 pm. item.title: NTPC Bongaigaon Celebrates 77th Republic Day with Grandeur and Patriotic Fervour
item.description: GUWAHATI: NTPC Bongaigaon, the flagship power station of NTPC in the North-East, celebrated the 77th Republic Day at its plant premises, amidst a range of activities. The celebrations commenced with the unfurling of the National Flag by Arnab Maitra, Head of Project, NTPC Bongaigaon, followed by the inspection of a ceremonial parade comprising contingents from the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF), DGR Security Services, CISF Fire Wing, and students of Notre Dame Academy. item.title: “Americans Should Leave Iran Now”: US Embassy Asks US Citizens Ahead of US-Iran Talks in Oman
item.description: GUWAHATI: The virtual US Embassy in Iran has issued an urgent advisory to its citizens in Iran, asking them to leave the country immediately, citing escalating protests and consequent arrests and injuries. The warning comes ahead of US-Iran talks in Oman over Tehran’s nuclear program and regional security concerns. item.title: Tripartite Pact Signed to Address Long-Pending Aspirations of Eastern Nagaland
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Government of India, the Government of Nagaland, and representatives of the Eastern Nagaland Peoples’ Organisation (ENPO) on Thursday, February 5, signed a landmark tripartite agreement in New Delhi, paving the way for the formation of the Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority (FNTA). item.title: Delhi Police Dismiss ‘Missing Girls Surge’ Claims, Say Rumours Fuelled by Paid Promotion
item.description: GUWAHATI: Delhi Police on Friday, February 6, dismissed claims of a sudden spike in missing girls and children in the national capital, stating that such narratives were being amplified through paid promotions to create panic. The police warned that strict legal action would be taken against those spreading fear for monetary gain.
